correctness.rationale: The explicit 16-state marked Boolean transfer characterizes all nonempty disjoint forts on the cyclic prism, with T0^5=T0^6 verified by exact bit-matrix arithmetic. All 25,013 compressed cyclic words of weight <=4 are checked; the stabilization lemma extends them to all lengths. Independently implemented forcing directly confirms all compressed words and every four-set in rings n=6..15. Five templates are the only four-sets passing, and a separate symbolic local enumeration plus cyclic exceptional checks proves degrees 12,8,8,8,5. Exchange paths connect all five orbits and consecutive square configurations.

value.rationale: A natural and widely studied cubic infinite family receives its full optimum-solution classification, fourth coefficient of the zero-forcing polynomial, symmetry-stratified degree distribution and a constructive connectedness result for the natural token-jump exchange graph. None is implied by the previously known optimum forcing number of four. This is a precise structural classification of all feasible optima, not an arbitrary finite parameter or a routine rephrasing.
